subject: Execution cadence & canary plan for SummitCare rollout
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@summitcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Execution cadence & canary plan for SummitCare rollout

Hi Nora — congrats on signing. Per our SOW and the MAP we discussed, attached is a pragmatic execution cadence we recommend for the first 90 days. High level: staging canary -> litmus migration -> staggered production roll -> training waves.

Primary asks for SummitCare this week:
- Confirm the first canary cohort (5 clinics) and target go-live window (we suggested Apr 10–12).
- Share the internal contact for on-call during canary (name + pager/email).
- Confirm training cadence (we proposed two half-day sessions for power users on Apr 5 and Apr 12).

I've attached MAP_SummitCare_v1.2.xlsx with timelines and owner matrix, plus a short canary-checklist.pdf. Please review and flag anything that blocks the Apr window.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0146
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@summitcare.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@summitcare.com>, IT <it@summitcare.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution cadence & canary plan for SummitCare rollout

Avery — thanks and congrats to the team. Quick confirmations from our side:
- We can do a 5-clinic canary. I'll confirm the exact clinic names by EOD tomorrow.
- On-call: Carlos Mejia (carlos.mejia@summitcare.com) will be our internal lead during canary; he can escalate to our NOC if needed.
- Training: Apr 5 works for power users. Apr 12 is tight for some regional directors; if needed we can run an additional session on Apr 14.

One ask: can you break out the MAP spreadsheet into "must-have" vs "nice-to-have" tasks in the first 30 days? That will help with exec sign-off.

— Nora
Nora Patel
VP, Clinical Ops, SummitCare
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@summitcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution cadence & canary plan for SummitCare rollout

Thanks Nora — that's helpful. Per your request I've flagged the MAP into two lanes: "Critical (MVP)" and "Phase 1 (enhancements)"; see tab 1 in the attached MAP_SummitCare_v1.2.xlsx. Short notes:
- Critical includes: data routing validation, KV cache policies for patient-sensitive prefixes, fallback model variant for latency spikes, canary rollback script, and basic training for power users.
- Phase 1 includes: advanced prompt templating, additional automations, and expanded monitoring dashboards.

Marissa / Rishi: can you confirm the canary rollback SLA and whether we should lock quantization to the verified profile during canary?

Attachments: MAP_SummitCare_v1.2.xlsx, canary-checklist.pdf

Avery
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@summitcare.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution cadence & canary plan for SummitCare rollout

Nora/Avery — quick canary details from the ops side:
- Canary cohort: 5 clinics, rolling split across 2 AZs to test region failover (we'll coordinate with your IT).
- Rollback plan: automated traffic cut (0–100% in 3 minutes) + immediate model variant switch to a lower-latency quantized profile if token latency exceeds 350ms p50 for 5 consecutive minutes.
- Incident runbook: we will open a dedicated Slack channel (redwood-summitcare-canary) and a shared PagerDuty escalation.

Training note: we will provide recorded short-form exercises (15–20 min) for end users in addition to the live sessions. Rishi, Soojin — please attach the training-schedule.csv and confirm trainers.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@summitcare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Patel <nora.patel@summitcare.com>, IT <it@summitcare.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution cadence & canary plan for SummitCare rollout

Marissa — thanks. A few constraints from our side:
1) We cannot run canaries across AZs that span different billing regions for regulatory reasons; we need both canary clusters in the same US-west region.
2) On-call coverage between Apr 10–16 will be reduced because of a pre-scheduled vendor migration — I can provide a limited window each day (09:00–13:00 PT).

Given (1) and (2), can we compress the canary to two consecutive days (Apr 10–11) within US-west and keep the rollback SLA? I'll work with IT to ensure the necessary firewall exceptions are applied.

— Carlos
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@summitcare.com>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@summitcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution cadence & canary plan for SummitCare rollout

Carlos — appreciate the constraints. Proposal to accommodate:
- Move both canary clusters to US-west only.
- Compress to Apr 10–11 with focused test windows 09:00–13:00 PT each day. Redwood ops will staff overlapping support 08:30–14:30 PT to ensure timely rollback if needed.
- Training: keep Apr 5 for power users; add a makeup session Apr 14 for regional directors. We will push short recordings before Apr 5.

Action owners and next steps (finalizing by EOD Fri):
- Nora: confirm clinic list for canary (owner).
- Carlos: confirm firewall/IP allowlist and on-call windows (owner).
- Marissa: finalize rollback automation and attach training-schedule.csv (owner).
- Rishi: prepare canary metrics dashboard and alert thresholds (owner).
- Avery: coordinate DocuSign final countersign, upload MAP to the shared Confluence, and schedule the kickoff.

If I don't hear objections, we'll treat Apr 10–11 as the target canary window and update the MAP.

Thanks all — excited to get this live.

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
